g.title: chains_grounding
g.text: Hypergraph / Shard / Metagraph chains — finality-tiered grounding
(A0 tip → A1 ride → A2 economic → A3 settlement)
δ = the A2 density-confirmation depth (slots) — the metagraph latency-vs-stability knob. Left = older / buried · Right = tip / now.

g.title: Legend
g.text: Finality tier of a gl0 snapshot (color = tier reached at "now")
attestation-final — ≥2/3 stake attested; reorgs under churn
depth-stable — A1 + δ-slot density confirmation (deep density reorg only, negligible)
grounds-on / re-exec base @A2 — solid green (economic base)
bold = each lane's LIVE tip binding · thin dashed = a trailing node's anchor, since matured deeper (same grounding type)
shard committee checkpoint — straddles A1 ride + A2 base
metagraph (ml0) currency snapshot — grounds on A2
external consumer — light client / cross-shard, settles on A3

g.title: Note
g.text: • Producers sit at the tip (now) and reach BACK by their trust need:
ride @A1 = 1 back · economic @A2 = 2–3 back · settle @A3 = 4–6 back.
• The metagraph tip M(j) trails the gl0 tip by the A2 (δ) lag — that is the
latency it pays for a density-stable economic base.
• Bold labeled edges = each lane's LIVE tip binding. Thin edges = trailing
nodes, whose anchors grounded the same way and have since matured deeper.
